intro: The Shaman Voodoo Charm is a dark ritual trinket carried by Gnarlpine furbolg shamans deep within the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Emanating a vile aura, this charm channels an unnatural magic capable of severing a slumbering druid's spirit from their physical flesh.

p: The Gnarlpine tribe of Teldrassil has fallen into madness and corruption, but within the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, their shamans wield powers far beyond ordinary wilderness sorcery. Utilizing these strange voodoo charms, the shamans discovered a way to rip a sleeping druid's consciousness away from the mortal realm and trap it helplessly within the Emerald Dream. By severing the soul from the vessel, the furbolgs are able to animate the empty physical form, turning venerable night elf protectors into mindless guardians that slaughter anyone venturing into the barrows.
